news.detail: Bates played 22 of the Commanders' 71 offensive snaps in his start. The tight end was primarily used as a blocker for the team's run game but did not steal any targets from Ben Sinnott in the effort.

profile: role: TE3 rotational — 7% of targets, 49% of snaps.
